description: One-time explicitly authorised Aippy host dependency update: remove unused direct AI SDK dependency without replacing the Aippy runtime.
notes: For THIS import only, allow replacement of the two named root host files even if normally excluded by the GitHub importer.
Do not import entire upstream tree or rewrite any other file.
Aippy runtime declares ai as a peer dependency; transitive lock entries can remain. Removing direct ai does not guarantee the platform warning disappears.
Stage both exact files before replacement, backup both, replace, verify, build; rollback on failure.
